findings.title: Update on Cybersecurity Event at UNM Health Sciences Center
findings.publisher: University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center
findings.exact_supporting_passage: At 2:30 p.m., UNM Health began resuming operations and bringing systems back online in phases, as it was safe to do so.
findings.service_line: Hospital clinical operations and new-patient acceptance; specific emergency/trauma and ambulance-diversion restoration not established
findings.access_consequences: UNM Health's official 6:08 p.m. local update says new-patient acceptance was limited from 12:30–2:30 p.m. MDT and operations began resuming in phases at 2:30 p.m. MDT. This is a verified partial restoration following the previously recorded cybersecurity-related loss of access. Outpatient surgeries and appointments remained suspended for the rest of October 26; the update does not certify full hospital, emergency department, trauma-center, ambulance, or clinic restoration.
findings.affected_population: Patients seeking new admission or essential care across UNM Health System in Albuquerque and greater New Mexico; outpatient patients with canceled appointments and procedures continue to be affected.

duplicate_review.distinction: Restoration phase is a distinct access change and not a second report of the original outage. Current report is a late recall of an earlier service-change: official update labeled 6:08 p.m. New Mexico local time (5:08 p.m. PDT), before preceding heartbeat completed. Previous heartbeat explicitly said no confirmed restoration. Preserve chronology and seek production deduplication before editorial use.

coverage_notes.limitations: Phased operations resumption is confirmed, but specific ED/trauma intake, ambulance diversion, clinic reopening, and fully restored clinical operations were not individually confirmed. Search engines may not index all hourly changes.
